sources.excerpt: Strand 2 LIVING THINGS & THEIR ENVIRONMENT. 2.1 The Cell. Cells make up the structure of living organisms and carry out various biological processes. Organisms such as amoeba are composed of a single cell hence are said to be unicellular.
